6. Where the complete construction attempt fails

The current attempt reached this represented, unfinished state:

Item	Current result
Attachment/detachment/transfer operations	432
Event records	716
Installed field members	6
Installed crossframes	4
Represented recovery	1 pose correction
Modeled duration	9.16884 h
Modeled process electricity	9.37424 kWh
Complete reference services	0
Accepted physical services	0

It stops at the first top-web transfer because the empty floor handler’s declared route overlaps a fixed-holder chassis by 97.76 mm.

The full independent access audit finds more failures:

Screen	Span	Cantilever	Changed-access frame
Composite whole-member routes passing	0/35	0/21	9/35
Floor-handler targets passing	30/35	18/21	30/35

Additional results are:

Probe routes: 64/91 pass.
Whole-tool berths: 4/5 pass.
Worst ordinary carried-packet margin: −48.6 mm.
Worst captured-fault packet margin: −80.79 mm.
Worst probe/fixed-holder margin: −58.77 mm.

These are failures of the declared swept paths. They are not proofs that no alternative path or architecture exists.

Withdrawal is also incomplete

All sixteen modeled support-return sequences complete locally, but five parked states miss the declared 5 mm clearance for subsequent carriage motion and thermal variation:

Family and station	Calculated future gap
Span, station 2	3.707 mm
Span, station 3	4.328 mm
Cantilever, station 3	2.678 mm
Changed-access frame, station 2	4.286 mm
Changed-access frame, station 3	4.621 mm

These are positive gaps, so the calculation does not assert immediate contact. They nevertheless fail the chosen admission margin. The six bases are fixed; an unspecified relocation is not an available recovery operation.

At the stopped prefix, 79 bars remain in the rack and six remain installed. Four crossframes remain installed, all rails remain in stock, and no jammed assemblies have reached quarantine. The carriage battery has fallen from 40 Wh to 38.166 Wh. No full reset restores that inventory.

The normal-head interference also means that the first 432 event records cannot be promoted into 432 physically qualified operations.
